# Aleksandr Riakhin — Senior iOS Software Engineer

This site is the personal portfolio of Aleksandr Riakhin, a Senior iOS Software Engineer specializing in Swift, SwiftUI, and modern iOS architecture. It showcases Aleksandr's own apps (El Recreo, My Dictionary, Flippin, Replex, PureBite, Guaraní Converter, Price Wizard), professional experience, and contact links. See /index.md for app descriptions and App Store links.
